pages.text: The Fortune Upgrade in Refined Storage 2 enhances the Destructor's block breaking capabilities with improved efficiency and better reliability. When installed, it applies fortune-level effects to blocks broken by the Destructor, increasing resource yields with enhanced precision. RS2 features improved upgrade handling and better compatibility with modded blocks.

Features:$(li)Increases fortune level$(li)Works in Destructors$(li)Increases power consumption$(li)Three levels available (Fortune I, II, and III)$(li)Higher levels provide greater base fortune effect

To use the Fortune Upgrade:$(li)Right-click on a Destructor$(li)Insert the upgrade into an upgrade slot$(li)Multiple upgrades can be installed$(li)Each upgrade will increase power consumption$(li)Higher level upgrades provide more fortune per slot
Fortune I Upgrade - Provides base fortune level 1
Fortune II Upgrade - Provides base fortune level 2
Fortune III Upgrade - Provides base fortune level 3
